purpose: Determine on disjoint matched simulator branches whether the frozen WM-v2B proprio counterfactual failure is repairable by closed-form scalar calibration without neural-model training.

calibration.role: fit scalar parameters only; never report as held-out evidence

evaluation.role: held-out final calibration evaluation; never fit or select calibration form

historical_reference.use: distribution-shift reference only; forbidden for fitting, form selection, or thresholds

branch_construction.reference_path: Run frozen C0-v2 actor-default open-loop chunks from the official init state through planning index 8.
branch_construction.branch_path: For each candidate, create a fresh independent environment, seed/reset/set the same official init state, replay the identical 64 raw physical prefix actions, then execute the copied eight-action candidate.
branch_construction.candidate_generator: Frozen C1-v2.1 deterministic antithetic smoothed Gaussian at production 1x scale; candidate tensor generated once and copied to all branches.

prefix_identity_gate.executed_raw_prefix_actions: bitwise equal float32 arrays and identical SHA-256
prefix_identity_gate.agentview_rgb: bitwise equal uint8 arrays and identical SHA-256
prefix_identity_gate.planning_observation: same keys, shapes, dtypes, and bitwise-equal numeric arrays
prefix_identity_gate.failure_action: stop the affected partition immediately, retain only a replay blocker artifact, and do not fit or evaluate calibration

calibration_models.fit_rule: closed-form no-intercept least squares alpha=sum(delta_pred*delta_real)/sum(delta_pred^2), using calibration partition only
calibration_models.global_scalar: one alpha shared by all horizons and coordinates; diagnostic
calibration_models.per_horizon_scalar: eight alphas, one per horizon; fixed primary authorization form because overscaling is historically horizon-dependent
calibration_models.groupwise_scalar: three alphas for preregistered ee_pos/gripper/joints groups; diagnostic and partial-mediator form
calibration_models.horizon_group_scalar: 24 alphas; fit and freeze from calibration data, but evaluate only as a secondary diagnostic if all three simpler forms fail the aggregate zero-baseline gate; never authorizes GO in this experiment
calibration_models.negative_alpha_rule: report mechanism abnormality and fail the corresponding calibration form; never take absolute value or clip
calibration_models.evaluation_form_selection: forbidden; per_horizon_scalar is fixed as the only full-mediator authorization form before evaluation

metrics.ranking: within-context Spearman over three candidate-pair norms, pair-of-pair ordering accuracy with ties worth 0.5, and pooled Pearson/Spearman
metrics.sign: per-dimension sign agreement where abs(real_delta) reaches threshold

bootstrap.unit: held-out matched branch point; resampling retains all three candidate pairs, all eight horizons, and all 12 coordinates

authorization_gate.aggregate_zero_improvement: improvement_zero >= 0.05 and branch-block 95% CI lower bound > 0
authorization_gate.aggregate_raw_improvement: improvement_raw > 0 and branch-block 95% CI lower bound > 0
authorization_gate.direction: mean cosine >= 0.10 and branch-block 95% CI lower bound > 0
authorization_gate.ranking: within-context Spearman >= 0.10 with CI lower > 0; ordering accuracy >= 0.55 with CI lower > 0.50
authorization_gate.candidate_pair_consistency: every A0-A1/A0-A2/A1-A2 pair has improvement_zero > 0, direction > 0, and magnitude ratio-of-means in [0.5,1.5]
authorization_gate.full_gripper_validity: real sign-eligible coverage >= 0.10; improvement_zero >= 0.05 with CI lower > 0; direction >= 0.10 with CI lower > 0; sign accuracy >= 0.55 with CI lower > 0.50
authorization_gate.positive_alpha: all eight primary per-horizon alphas are strictly positive
authorization_gate.full_pass: all primary-form aggregate, pair, ranking, direction, gripper, and positive-alpha checks pass -> PHYSICAL_MEDIATOR_CALIBRATION_PASS and GO_WM_V2C_DESIGN
authorization_gate.partial_group_gate: under frozen groupwise calibration, ee_pos or joints has improvement_zero >= 0.05 with CI lower > 0, direction >= 0.10 with CI lower > 0, and sign accuracy >= 0.55 with CI lower > 0.50, while the full gate fails because gripper fails -> PARTIAL_PHYSICAL_MEDIATOR_PASS; authorization remains BLOCK
authorization_gate.retrain: if full and partial gates fail, or no simple calibration form significantly beats zero, output PHYSICAL_MEDIATOR_RETRAIN_REQUIRED and BLOCK_WM_V2C_PHYSICAL_MEDIATOR

forbidden: fit on or inspect evaluation branches before calibration freeze is committed
use init states 30/35 for fitting, model selection, or thresholds
train or modify WM-v2B or any neural calibration model
clip, sign-correct, or iteratively tune fitted alpha values
select calibration form from evaluation results
modify candidate generator, production scale, reranker, C0-v2, or controllers
run C1/C2 success, D20-v2, task-success selection, reward, done, or fake targets
train or design WM-v2C in this experiment
